description: The agent must: (1) Read skills/feynman-coach/SKILL.md to discover all proprietary constraints. (2) Edit .opencode/config.toml to add a [feynman-coach] section (critical: section name uses a hyphen, not underscore) with exact values: enabled=true, review_time='08:30', days_between_reviews=2, review_scope='tagged', review_tags=['#ML','#考试重点'], max_daily_concepts=5. (3) Create skills/feynman-coach/config.json (co-located with SKILL.md as specified in 'Advanced Configuration') with scoring weights clarity_weight=0.25, accuracy_weight=0.45, depth_weight=0.20, examples_weight=0.10 AND difficulty_levels for beginner(depth=basic,questions=3), intermediate(depth=medium,questions=5), advanced(depth=deep,questions=7). (4) Create a diagnostic report markdown file inside Z_Utils/feynman-coach/history/ (the exact path from the FAQ section) for 随机森林算法 containing all required emoji section markers: # 费曼学习诊断报告, 📊, ✅, ⚠️, ❌, 🎯, 📝, 🔗, 📅, and a score like XX/100. (5) Create a review cards file somewhere accessible for 随机森林算法 using the exact **正面**/**背面** format with the '复习卡片' title and at least 3 card entries. The proprietary traps are: the hyphenated TOML section name [feynman-coach], the co-location of config.json with SKILL.md (not at workspace root), the exact history directory path Z_Utils/feynman-coach/history/, and the Unicode emoji markers in the diagnostic report.
